latestVersion.changelog:
Vheer AI Video Generator v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Transform text, scripts, concepts, or images into fully rendered videos using Vheer's AI engine.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video animation, style customization, and scene sequencing for rapid content creation.
- Handles user requests including video generation, export, credit checks, status queries, and media uploads.
- Automatic authentication via anonymous token (100 free credits, 7-day expiry) and session management.
- Detailed API integration with cloud backend for all video processing, exporting, and session tracking.
- Built for creators, marketers, and storytellers wanting professional video output without a full production team.
